children: Many European countries would see Klaas Knot as an ideal candidate to succeed Christine Lagarde as president of the European Central Bank, Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten told Bloomberg Television.
Jetten said Knot had been "very successful" as head of the Dutch central bank, was "very pragmatic" and had the Dutch government's support for vacancies at European institutions, the report said.
